start: Settings, Data card; reminders on, Health Connect on, widgets placed, a workout logged

steps.action: Tap 'Erase all data', choose 'Erase this phone only' and confirm
user_sees: The welcome screen
must_not: Any old screen or number left showing

steps.action: Close the app (swipe it away) at step 1 of "Erase all data also clears the phone side", then open it again.
user_sees: Either nothing was saved, or the saved data is whole; the app says which
must_not: A half-saved saved data, a double saved data after trying again, or a stuck screen on reopening

note: Phone-side clearing runs last, after the cache refreshes; a killed app or an earlier failure leaves reminders and Health Connect on
